name: 60025 · Glenview, IL
findings: ZIP 60025 (Glenview) has 187 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60025 (Glenview) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
